_comment: What GET /api/org/backup/targets answers, as BOTH implementations assert it: CredVaultServer.Tests.BackupEndpointTests.TheTargetsRouteAnswersTheSharedFixtureShape seeds these two destinations and compares the route's answer to this document; src_vs_code/src/test/orgBackupClient.test.ts feeds `targets` verbatim to readTargets and asserts it is accepted. One file, so a field renamed on one side goes red on the other. `credentials` is the only field that is not a location: `sealed` means this server can open what is sealed for the destination, `unopenable` means it cannot (a KEK that changed, a settings file restored from elsewhere, no KEK at all) and the form says re-enter. Never a key, never iv/tag/data. The values are fixtures — https://s3.example.com and acct.blob.core.windows.net are not real destinations.
